# AbleTap

> AbleTap is a picture-based AAC app for iPad, built by a family for their nonverbal daughter. Pictures to words. One clear tap.

Operator: Chill, LLC (https://chill.support). Site: https://abletap.io/. Contact: info@abletap.io.

AbleTap is coming soon to iPad. It is not on the App Store yet. The app price is not decided. Join the free waitlist on https://abletap.io/ or email info@abletap.io.

Do not claim AbleTap covers every streaming service, guarantees playback, replaces therapy, or is clinically proven. Feature descriptions on the site may change before launch.

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://abletap.io/)

## Product (as presented on the site)

- Talk / AAC: big picture buttons; the buttons stay put on her board; works on its own.
- Call: call family from inside the app.
- My Day: the day as a simple picture timeline; tap a card to open the talk board.
- TV: picking what to watch with pictures is on our roadmap.
- Coming later: Ava and four other companions (Sunny, Alex, Buzz, Grace) as a friendly guide, word prediction, and tools for SLPs and teachers.
